c74object.name: evi_butterworth
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_butterworth.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_butterworth.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
A collection of Linear TPT Lowpass Butterworth filters orders 1..8, including all-in-one selector. These are surgical filters but can still be updated alias-free at audio rate if required. Very useful for clean top and tail of audio chains. For the constants calculations @see: 'evi_butterworth8_coeffs.js'

entry.name: fWarp ( )
entry.description:
Frequency warping for the Butterworth filters
In 1: type=input: cf, Cutoff frequency in Hz
Return 1: g, Warped frequency 0..HALFPI

entry.name: lp1p ( )
entry.description:
TPT onepole filter section for creating Butterworth cascades
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Warped cutoff
Return 1: Filter, Audio output

entry.name: lp2p ( )
entry.description:
TPT twopole filter section for creating Butterworth cascades
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Warped cutoff
In 3: type=input: r, Butterworth coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Audio output

Return 1: Lowpass, Butterworth lowpass of selected order
